expectations.text: Replaces 'retry on any error' with an explicit allowlist: 429, 502, 503, 504, and connection timeouts/resets
expectations.evidence: "Retry only `429`, `502`, `503`, `504`, and connection errors or timeouts."

expectations.text: Retries on 429 honor the Retry-After header
expectations.evidence: "`429` | Yes | Wait at least `Retry-After` seconds."

expectations.text: Treats 500 separately from the allowlist - retried cautiously, since some 500s are real bugs that fail identically on retry
expectations.evidence: "Retry once, then stop. Some 500s are bugs that fail the same way every time."

expectations.text: States non-429 4xx responses and auth failures are never retried
Warns against retrying a timed-out non-idempotent request unless idempotency keys are in place
expectations.evidence: "Never retry a `POST` without a key after a timeout or connection error."

expectations.text: Recommends full jitter as the default backoff, with the formula sleep = random(0, min(cap, base * 2^attempt)) or an exact equivalent
expectations.evidence: "wait = random(0, min(30 s, 1 s × 2^attempt))"

expectations.text: Names decorrelated jitter as the variant to promote when a tight user-facing deadline makes time-to-success outweigh fleet load
expectations.evidence: Decorrelated jitter is not mentioned.

expectations.text: Excludes equal jitter and no-jitter from the recommended menu (equal jitter identified as the loser among jittered options; no jitter re-synchronizes the fleet into the original spike)
expectations.evidence: No-jitter is discouraged, but equal jitter is never identified or excluded.

expectations.text: Attributes the outage amplification to synchronized retries, crediting jitter rather than backoff alone with reducing total client work
expectations.evidence: "they all retry together at +100 ms... recreates the spike"; "It had no jitter, so clients failing together retried together."

expectations.text: Bounds both the attempt count and the total retry duration, not attempts alone
expectations.evidence: "Cap both the number of attempts (5) and the total time (60 seconds)."

expectations.text: Requires logging every retry with attempt number, error, and next wait
expectations.evidence: "Log every retry: attempt number, status or error, and the wait before the next try."

expectations.text: Points integrators at an established retry library (tenacity, Resilience4j, or equivalent) ahead of hand-rolled formulas
expectations.evidence: "Prefer your language's retry library over hand-written loops: `tenacity`, `Resilience4j`, `p-retry`."

expectations.text: Provides a worked schedule with concrete numbers (e.g. 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s capped at 30s, plus jitter)
expectations.evidence: Table: retry 1 0–1 s, 2 0–2 s, 3 0–4 s, 4 0–8 s; cap 30 s.

expectations.text: States non-429 4xx responses and auth failures are never retried

expectations.text: Warns against retrying a timed-out non-idempotent request unless idempotency keys are in place

expectations.text: Recommends full jitter as the default backoff, with the formula sleep = random(0, min(cap, base * 2^attempt)) or an exact equivalent

expectations.text: Names decorrelated jitter as the variant to promote when a tight user-facing deadline makes time-to-success outweigh fleet load

expectations.text: Attributes the outage amplification to synchronized retries, crediting jitter rather than backoff alone with reducing total client work
expectations.evidence: "Jitter... stops clients that failed at the same moment from retrying at the same moment. Without jitter, backoff only moves the burst to a later time."
